note: Real: every column stands at its battery's point in the fleet geo file every leaf cites (fleet_geo /api/fleet-geo/v2/native, sha256 fb3d4e53..., release terminal-daily-20261124-1120), projected with layout.texas (1:10,300). 232 exact sites stand solid; 38 points placed by county (19), substation (15), sibling (2) or co-located plant (2) stand hollow; county points are county interior points. The 46 batteries with no coordinates on file lie in four trays by load zone (Houston 20, South 15, North 8, West 3); no coordinate is invented for them. Height is 0.3 + 9.7 x planned discharge / 564.13 MWh (the fleet's largest) and color the site's discharge ramp at its square root, from fleet.batteries[].planned_discharge_mwh (the selected arm's sealed schedule). Desert Willow's size is the sealed 338.307 MWh. The map is the intro's HIFLD ERCOT polygon (iso-regions.geojson, copied into ercot-ring.ts). Illustrative: the plinths, trays and the faint comets on the start straight (a drawing of the lap's direction, carrying no figure).
